question: Which Photoshop desktop version number did Adobe release on November 10, 2026, alongside Adobe MAX 2026?
answer:
I can't confirm that. My knowledge doesn't extend to Adobe's releases around MAX 2026, and I have no way to look up the release notes, so I won't guess at a version number.

For context, Photoshop's desktop numbering has followed a pattern: 25.x was the 2024 line, 26.x the 2025 line, and the October 2025 MAX release was 27.0. By that pattern, a late-2026 MAX release would likely be 28.0, but that's an inference, not a verified fact. Also, I can't confirm that a release actually landed on November 10, 2026.

The reliable place to check is Adobe's "What's new in Photoshop" page or the Photoshop release notes on helpx.adobe.com. Inside the app, Help > About Photoshop shows the installed version, and the Creative Cloud desktop app shows the available update.
